title: 第11章 不速之客第12章 搏杀群鼠
slug: 迷雾求生从流民开始的领主之路
content_zh:
木板掀开的刹那，一股陈腐阴湿的气息扑面而来。
亚修并没有急着下去。
他侧身避开涌出的浊气，等了几秒，才借着半塌屋顶缝隙漏下的暗淡光线，小心地探头向下望去。
地窖不大，约莫三四平米见方，一眼就能望到底。
角落里孤零零地立着一个简陋的木架，除此之外别无他物。
光线太暗，看不清架上具体有什么，只能勉强分辨出几个深色的轮廓。
并没有想象中的食物或水。
但看清那些东西的形状后，亚修的呼吸却猛地一滞。
那是……装备？
他反手将短矛靠在墙边，双手撑住地窖边缘，如同狸猫般无声地滑落坑底。
落脚处是夯实过的泥地，阴冷潮湿。
亚修还没等站稳身体，便几步跨到木架前，伸手拂去了上面厚积的灰尘。
那是一面圆盾，一柄带鞘短剑，还有一件折叠整齐的硬皮甲。
又出货了！
亚修呼吸一滞，随即一股强烈的欣喜涌上心头！
他下意识地舔了舔突然有些发干的嘴唇，立刻将它们一一拿起，幽蓝色的属性面板随之浮现：
【粗制圆木盾（白）】
【防御：15】
【耐久：2525】
【备注：几块硬木板拼接而成，虽不美观，但这厚度足以挡下利爪的撕扯。】

……
【制式短剑（白）】
【伤害：5-9】
【耐久：2020】
【备注：像是某个落魄佣兵留下的副手武器，剑刃尚且锋利。】
……
【硬化皮甲（白）】
【防御：5】
【耐久：3030】
【备注：经过油脂浸泡和硬化处理的兽皮，能有效缓冲钝击和切割伤害。】
全白板，零词条。
但在亚修眼里，这几行字比什么都可爱。
他实在想不出原主人为何会将这些保命的家伙留在这里。
也许是仓促逃离不及带走，也许发生了什么意外。
但此刻，这些都无关紧要了。
这些装备对他来说，无异于雪中送炭！
亚修几乎是迫不及待地行动起来。
先将那件略显沉重的皮甲拎起，将之套在身上。
冰凉的皮甲贴上皮肤，激起一层鸡皮疙瘩。
content_en:
The moment the wooden board was opened, a stale and dank smell hit his face.
Ash was in no hurry to go down.
He turned sideways to avoid the gushing air, waited for a few seconds, and then carefully looked down through the dim light leaking from the gap in the half-collapsed roof.
The cellar is not big, about three or four square meters, and you can see the bottom at a glance.
There was a simple wooden frame standing alone in the corner, and nothing else.
The light was too dark to see clearly what was on the shelf, and I could only make out a few dark outlines.
There was no food or water as expected.
But after seeing the shapes of those things clearly, Ash's breathing suddenly stopped.
That's... equipment?
He leaned the short spear against the wall with his backhand, supported the edge of the cellar with both hands, and slid silently to the bottom of the pit like a civet cat.
The footing was on compacted mud, cold and damp.
Before Ash could stand upright, he took a few steps to the wooden frame and brushed away the thick dust on it.
It was a round shield, a sheathed short sword, and a piece of neatly folded hard leather armor.
Shipping again!
Ash's breath froze, and then a strong joy surged into his heart!
He subconsciously licked his suddenly dry lips, and immediately picked them up one by one, and a faint blue attribute panel appeared:
[Rough wooden shield (white)]
[Defense: 15]
[Durability: 2525]
[Note: It is made of several hard boards. Although it is not beautiful, it is thick enough to stop the tearing of sharp claws. 】
…
【Standard Dagger (White)】
[Damage: 5-9]
【Durability: 2020】
[Note: It looks like an off-hand weapon left by a down-and-out mercenary. The blade is still sharp. 】
…
[Hardened Leather Armor (White)]
[Defense: 5]
[Durability: 3030]
[Remarks: Animal hides soaked in oil and hardened can effectively buffer blunt blows and cutting injuries. 】
Full whiteboard, zero entries.
But in Ash's eyes, these lines were cuter than anything else.
He really couldn't figure out why the original owner would leave these life-saving guys here.
Maybe he escaped in a hurry and couldn't take him away, maybe something unexpected happened.
But at this moment, none of that mattered.
To him, these equipments are like giving timely help!
Ash almost couldn't wait to take action.
First, he picked up the slightly heavy leather armor and put it on his body.
The cold leather armor touched the skin, causing goosebumps.
